verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent ingestion and integration pieces: Snowpipe loads files from a stage in micro-batches, dbt Projects runs managed dbt (an ELT transformation tool) with a documented migration path, and REST APIs let partners build integrations. Nothing shows first-party or partner connectors for SaaS apps or source databases. Missing for 10: documented first-party connectors for SaaS apps and databases, a partner ETL/ELT connector ecosystem with setup guides, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connector coverage.
